text:
**Headline.** The first locked pair does not support claiming the candidate improved identity extraction or carrier counts. Recall rose 77.23% → 77.93% (+0.70 pp) on 571 gold identities (120 attempts / 110 PMIDs), below the registered +1 pp discovery floor. One-sided 95% lower bounds (−0.17 pp recall, −1.29 pp precision) miss the NI limits (−1 pp / −2 pp). Carrier absolute error 933 → 802 (−14.0%) also fails: the registered upper 95% delta bound crosses zero. Affected 1288 → 1257 and unaffected 243 → 230 (combined −2.87%) are descriptive. A/U supplied 141 → 163 and exactly correct 109 → 129 are not registered endpoints. The PMID-bootstrap combined A/U MAE interval [−0.0806, −0.0087] is not an acceptance rule.

**Why the carrier number overclaims.** Of the net 131 carrier-error drop, 128 comes from one previously scored SCN5A paper that still supplies no A/U. On the predeclared previously-unscored subset (97 attempts / 92 PMIDs / 292 gold), recall +1.37 pp is offset by precision −0.82 pp and **carrier error +1.62% worse**. Combined A/U −7.5% with +25 supplied is again unregistered. The tranche includes 18 previously scored PMIDs; the 92-PMID subset is the cleaner signal. Omissions scored as zero mean an error drop can be abstention, not capture.

**Design, not score.** SCN5A 27566755 Table S1 is a variant **count** in 406 LQT3 patients; the body splits asymptomatic vs cardiac-event endpoints in a 391 follow-up cohort—carrier reading can improve while A/U stays blank. RYR2 25814417: 179 living + 6 genotyped SCD = 185; gold A73/U106 is on the 179 living; both systems predict A97/U62. The 179-row roster (VA 69/81/29; CVA 42/108/29) does not sum to that partition. BRCA2 26848529 gold is explicitly three variants; 74 extra carrier-bearing rows inflate FP with blank A/U. One Table 2 vs Supp 3 count conflict remains; those 74 are not validated.

**Forecast.** The 67.97% → central 74% (72–76%) recall and 15–25% combined A/U reduction applied to a **different opened hard cohort**, already mixed a substitution (+11 TP / 384 gold = +2.865 pp; −70/576 A/U = 12.15%), not a fresh score. Current pairs use a **different historical nine-file baseline**, frozen sources, and an unchanged candidate. Clinical-table work, patient-ID joins, and missing-roster acquisition are unimplemented. You cannot add this pair’s deltas to 67.97%. The prior range is engineering judgment, not a CI.

**Responsible update now.** Treat the reading-only identity lift as **not shown**. Do not treat −14% carrier error as a property of the candidate. Hold the 72–76% / 15–25% numbers; at most note that frozen-source reading produced a sub-threshold identity delta and a one-paper, unscored-subset-reversed carrier delta.

**Second pair (99 previously-unscored attempts / 90 PMIDs; same freeze, gold after lock) must, on registered denominators:** (i) identity +1 pp or NI bounds; (ii) carrier upper 95% delta bound ≤ 0; (iii) gains not concentrated in previously scored papers; (iv) unscored-subset carrier error not worse. Fail both pairs on frozen sources → withdraw or relabel the forecast as **acquisition-untested**. Pass only on this baseline’s expected delta—not 67.97%. Unregistered A/U MAE still does not accept.

**Next API spend.** Not more frozen-source reading after a failed discovery pair. Spend on the unimplemented missing-table acquisition and clinical-table / patient-ID joins—the only remaining proposals that could still justify the old A/U range—after the second pair reports.
thought:
The user wants a concise statistical and extraction-design review based ONLY on the facts they provided. No tools, no web, no file access, no experiments. At most 450 words. Methods review, not patien...The current second-pair tranche shows modest recall gain (+0.70 pp) that fails registered discovery minimum and NI bounds; carrier error drops 14 % but its 95 % upper delta crosses zero, so secondary also fails. Affected/unaffected errors improve 2.87 %; supplied A/U rises 25 % yet bootstrap MAE interval includes zero, confirming no registered acceptance. Omissions treated as zero inflate apparent gains. Source audits reveal SCN5A and RYR2 tables contain unrecoverable partition mismatches and non-exhaustive gold, so error reductions partly reflect abstention.

Design remains frozen-source, no tuning on first gold. Prior 22-paper forecast (different cohort) cannot be causally updated; clinical-table and patient-ID proposals stay unimplemented. Second tranche must establish statistically significant carrier-error reduction below zero-crossing bound and A/U MAE outside [-0.0806, -0.0087] before any forecast revision. Absent that, next API spend should target only verified table acquisition for the 18 previously-scored PMIDs already contaminating the tranche.
